key: Tch, all those sailor types keep trying to hit on me.
en: Tch, all those sailor types keep trying to hit on me.
ja: チッ、船員気取りの連中がしつこく口説いてくるんだから。

key: Like, protip, "bros", nobody is going to be impressed by you catcallin' them!
en: Like, protip, "bros", nobody is going to be impressed by you catcallin' them!
ja: あのさ、いい? 「兄弟」たち、冷やかしの声かけなんかで感心する女なんていないから!

key: It's not a compliment, just uncomfortable. Ugh!
en: It's not a compliment, just uncomfortable. Ugh!
ja: あれは褒め言葉じゃなくて、ただ不快なだけ。うへぇ!

key: All right, in just a bit, I can take the first train up to the Spyce, and have myself the meal of a lifetime to celebrate finally being back in work!
en: All right, in just a bit, I can take the first train up to the Spyce, and have myself the meal of a lifetime to celebrate finally being back in work!
ja: よし、もうすぐスパイス行きの始発に乗れる。ようやく仕事に復帰できたお祝いに、人生最高の食事をいただくわ!

key: Would you like to purchase a ticket? \ch[321,-1,Grandview Station,Goldenrod Station,Ivyline Station,Sunset Station,Heatherhill Station,Peony Station,Kingsbury Station]
en: Would you like to purchase a ticket? \ch[321,-1,Grandview Station,Goldenrod Station,Ivyline Station,Sunset Station,Heatherhill Station,Peony Station,Kingsbury Station]
ja: きっぷをお求めですか? \ch[321,-1,グランドビュー駅,コガネ駅,アイビーライン駅,サンセット駅,ヘザーヒル駅,ピオニー駅,キングスベリー駅]

key: Looks like another long day at work...
en: Looks like another long day at work...
ja: また今日も長い一日になりそうだ……

key: I'm in construction-- supply, specifically.
en: I'm in construction-- supply, specifically.
ja: 建設業をやってる――正確には資材の方だけどな。

key: Lemme tell you, Trainer.
en: Lemme tell you, Trainer.
ja: なあ、聞いてくれよ、トレーナー。

key: I don't know what challenges you face day-to-day, but the most difficult thing I ever do is pull myself out of bed and off to the job.
en: I don't know what challenges you face day-to-day, but the most difficult thing I ever do is pull myself out of bed and off to the job.
ja: あんたが毎日どんな苦労をしてるかは知らないが、オレにとって一番きついのは、ベッドから起き上がって仕事に向かうことなんだ。

key: Day in and day out, I gotta move and stock all those metal beams and shipping-whatnots...
en: Day in and day out, I gotta move and stock all those metal beams and shipping-whatnots...
ja: 来る日も来る日も、鉄骨だの輸送用の何だのを運んで積んで……

key: I can't do this for much longer. I don't have the strength.
en: I can't do this for much longer. I don't have the strength.
ja: もうこれ以上は続けられそうにない。体力がもたないんだ。

key: I've been thinking about if there were some way I could get a Pokémon to do it for me.
en: I've been thinking about if there were some way I could get a Pokémon to do it for me.
ja: 何とかポケモンに肩代わりさせられないかって、ずっと考えてるんだ。

key: Machoke are super popular for this line of business, but...
en: Machoke are super popular for this line of business, but...
ja: ゴーリキーはこの業界じゃ大人気なんだが……

key: Unfortunately, due to the old accident with Jim "Two Nose" Foster, Fighting-type worker Pokémon aren't allowed at my company anymore.
en: Unfortunately, due to the old accident with Jim "Two Nose" Foster, Fighting-type worker Pokémon aren't allowed at my company anymore.
ja: 残念ながら、昔あった「鼻二つのジム」ことフォスターの事故のせいで、うちの会社じゃかくとうタイプの作業用ポケモンはもう禁止されてるんだ。

key: I did some research, and apparently Probopass are able to control magnetism with some degree of specificity.
en: I did some research, and apparently Probopass are able to control magnetism with some degree of specificity.
ja: 調べてみたんだが、ダイノーズならある程度磁力を精密に操れるらしい。

key: I could use that to haul the metal around for me!
en: I could use that to haul the metal around for me!
ja: それを使えば、金属を運ばせられるんだ!

key: But fat chance I know where to pick up something like that.
en: But fat chance I know where to pick up something like that.
ja: でも、そんなもんどこで手に入るのか、皆目見当もつかないけどな。

key: Trainer, if you come across any Probopass, trade it to me! I've got a rare Egg I can give you!
en: Trainer, if you come across any Probopass, trade it to me! I've got a rare Egg I can give you!
ja: トレーナー、もしダイノーズを見かけたら、オレと交換してくれ! 珍しいタマゴをやれるぞ!

key: Darn, I was hoping you could be my lucky break.
en: Darn, I was hoping you could be my lucky break.
ja: ちぇっ、あんたが幸運をもたらしてくれるかと思ったんだけどな。

key: Maybe the only "lucky break" I'll get is when my back does.
en: Maybe the only "lucky break" I'll get is when my back does.
ja: オレに訪れる唯一の「ブレイク」は、腰が折れることくらいかもな。

key: What, you actually have one?
en: What, you actually have one?
ja: え、本当に持ってるのか?

key: Well, I'll be a Mankey's uncle. Give it here!
en: Well, I'll be a Mankey's uncle. Give it here!
ja: おいおい、こいつは驚いた。こっちに寄こしてくれ!

key: \PN traded Probopass for an egg!
en: \PN traded Probopass for an egg!
ja: \PNはダイノーズをタマゴと交換した!

key: You, my friend, are a hero among men.
en: You, my friend, are a hero among men.
ja: あんたは、まさに男たちの中のヒーローだよ。

key: Take care now!
en: Take care now!
ja: それじゃ、元気でな!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
